description: Gets one Australian retirement figure by an id from search_figures. Returns the value recorded for a date (as_at, or today in Sydney), the date it applies from and what that date means, conditions, exceptions, the official source by name, the date last checked and a citation of the figure's Retirement Wealth page. Values set by law but not yet in force are listed under upcoming. No value is returned for a date before the earliest recorded value, after today, or from the start of a value set by law not yet confirmed in force.

as_at.description: A date, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out for today's date in Sydney.

id.description: The figure id, such as concessional_cap. search_figures returns ids.

include_history.description: Also return the earlier recorded values, newest first. Default false.

name: get_figure

as_at.description: The date the value was looked up for.

citation.description: The figure's Retirement Wealth page, as an address and a title.

cite_as.description: A citation line: the value, its date, the official source by name, the date it was last checked and the figure's Retirement Wealth page.

data_release.description: The number of the data release these values come from.

derivation.description: The calculation that links this figure to the figures it is worked out from, or null.

earliest_recorded.description: The earliest date for which a value of this figure is held.

effective_from.description: The date the value applies from. effective_from_basis says what the date means.

effective_from_basis.description: value: the day this value started. provision: the day the current rule started; the number itself is older. as_at: a day the official source shows the value in force; the day it started is not recorded.

effective_to.description: The last day the value applies: the day before the next recorded value starts. Null when no later value is recorded, or when the end is not recorded.

exceptions.description: Exceptions. One marked modelled: false is not built into any calculation on this site.

former_id.description: Set when the id asked for is an earlier id of this figure.

history_truncated.description: True when history was cut short to keep the response small.

page.description: The figure's Retirement Wealth page: its value, conditions, change history and a link to its official source.

ratio.description: For rates, the same value as a plain ratio: 3.75 per cent is 0.0375. Otherwise null.

recorded.description: True when a value is recorded for as_at. False when it is not: the value fields are then null and note says why.

review_due.description: due: true when the figure's first scheduled review day after it was last checked (from) is on or before as_at, today in Sydney: the figure has not been checked against its source since that review. note says so in words when due is true. from is null for a figure with no fixed review days.

scope.description: What this site does and does not provide.

source.description: The official source, by publisher and title. Its address is on the figure's Retirement Wealth page.

status.description: in_force: the registry's current value. superseded: an earlier value.

today.description: Today's date in Sydney when the request was answered.

upcoming.description: Values set by law that are not the current value here: for a later date, or not yet confirmed in force.

verification.description: How the value was verified and the date it was last checked against its source.

title: Get a figure
